repos.description: Virtual machines for iOS and macOS
repos.summary_zh: UTM 是一款基于 QEMU 的 iOS 和 macOS 全系统虚拟化工具，支持 x86_64、ARM64、RISC-V 等 30 多种处理器架构。它提供 JIT 加速版本和无需越狱的 SE 解释器版本，可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上运行 Windows、Linux 等操作系统。利用 Hypervisor 和 Virtualization 框架实现硬件加速，是移动设备和桌面端的强大虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UTM is a full-featured system emulator and virtual machine host for iOS and macOS, built on QEMU. It supports 30+ processor architectures including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V, enabling users to run Windows, Linux, and other operating systems on iPhones, iPads, and Macs. The platform offers JIT-based acceleration for optimal performance and a special SE (Slow Edition) using threaded interpretation that requires no jailbreak. With native frontends leveraging latest Apple APIs and hardware acceleration via Hypervisor.framework and Virtualization.framework, UTM delivers a powerful cross-platform virtualization solution for both mobile and desktop environments.

repos.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
repos.summary_zh: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
repos.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

repos.description: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
repos.summary_zh: 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》iOS/macOS 兼容层，将 Switch 版游戏原生移植至 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。基于 aarch64 原生执行与 Metal 图形重实现，支持术士君临扩展、完整触控操作、60fps 流畅运行，用户自备游戏文件即可离线畅玩。
repos.summary_en: Open-source iOS/macOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with Reign of the Warlock. Runs the Switch build natively on Apple devices via aarch64 execution and Metal graphics reimplementation, with full touch controls and 60 fps.

repos.description: Standalone iOS app to spoof GPS location without jailbreak. Includes Shadowrocket/Surge/Loon/QX/Stash module.
repos.summary_zh: 无需越狱的iOS GPS位置伪造工具。利用代理软件HTTPS解密与MITM功能，拦截Apple定位响应，修改WiFi及蜂窝基站坐标，实现任意地点定位。基于原Go项目移植为JavaScript模块，适配Shadowrocket、Surge、Loon等五大平台。新增多格式兼容、运动状态伪造等功能。适用于隐私保护、应用测试与地图验证，配置参数简单，即导即用。
repos.summary_en: A jailbreak-free iOS GPS location spoofer that intercepts Apple's location responses via proxy apps' HTTPS decryption and MITM. It modifies WiFi and cell tower coordinates to fake any location. Ported from an original Go app to JavaScript modules for Shadowrocket, Surge, Loon, Quantumult X, and Stash. Adds cell tower spoofing, multi-format support, and motion state faking. Ideal for privacy protection, app testing, and map verification with simple config parameters.

repos.description: In-place tweak injection with insert_dylib and ChOma.
repos.summary_zh: TrollFools 是一款专为 TrollStore 设计的轻量级 tweak 注入工具，利用 insert_dylib 和 ChOma 实现 Mach-O 二进制文件的原地动态库注入。支持 iOS 14-17 系统应用及 App Store 应用的修改，无论是解密还是加密状态。采用 SwiftUI 开发，界面现代且体积小巧，旨在替代有缺陷的 optool，为越狱社区提供高效稳定的 tweak 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: TrollFools is a lightweight tweak injection tool specifically designed for TrollStore ecosystem, leveraging insert_dylib and ChOma to perform in-place dynamic library injection directly into Mach-O binaries. It supports iOS 14-17, capable of modifying removable system applications, decrypted App Store apps, and even encrypted App Store apps with bare dynamic libraries. Written entirely in SwiftUI, it delivers a modern user interface while maintaining a small package size. The project aims to replace the problematic optool by compiling a statically linked install_name_tool, providing the jailbreak community with a more reliable and efficient solution for tweak deployment.

repos.description: A translation-based Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs
repos.summary_zh: Stela 是面向 x86-64 PC 的通用 Apple Silicon 层，通过 UEFI 启动，集成 arm64-to-x86-64 翻译器（覆盖 3000+ 指令）、NVIDIA Metal 驱动（AIR 转 NIR）和 Apple silicon 硬件模型，使 macOS 27 能在 Intel/AMD 机器上运行。目前开发中，速度较慢。
repos.summary_en: Stela is a general-purpose Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs. It boots via UEFI, integrating an arm64-to-x86-64 translator (covering 3000+ instructions), a Metal driver for NVIDIA GPUs (AIR to NIR), and an Apple silicon hardware model, enabling macOS 27 to run on Intel/AMD machines. Currently in development, it is slow.

repos.description: Agent skills and an AI-native SwiftUI component library for iOS apps: animations, Metal shaders, charts, components and full-stack modules your coding agent can build from.
repos.summary_zh: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
repos.summary_en: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

repos.summary_zh: SatellaJailed 是一款专为 iOS 12-16 设计的应用内购买破解工具，支持非越狱（jailed）和部分越狱设备。通过动态库注入技术，它能在应用购买流程中拦截并绕过苹果的支付验证机制。工具提供三种安装方式：电脑脚本自动打补丁、Azula 应用补丁和 Esign 签名集成，支持 TrollStore 和 Dopamine 环境。使用时发起购买后取消确认弹窗即可。核心功能默认启用，iOS 15+ 用户可开启高级选项。注意并非所有应用都兼容。
repos.summary_en: SatellaJailed is an iOS 12-16 in-app purchase cracker designed for jailed and partially jailbroken devices. It employs dynamic library injection to intercept and bypass Apple's payment verification during purchase flows. The tool offers three installation methods: computer-based script patching, Azula app patching, and Esign signature integration, compatible with TrollStore and Dopamine environments. Users initiate a purchase and cancel the Apple ID confirmation popup to activate. Core functionality is enabled by default, with advanced features available for iOS 15+. Note that not all applications are supported, and success rates may vary depending on the target app.

repos.description: Launch JIT enabled iOS app with a second iOS device
repos.summary_zh: Jitterbug 是一款创新工具，通过两台 iOS 设备间 WiFi 配对，利用 libimobiledevice 实现跨设备调试，从而在非越狱设备上启用 JIT 编译。它支持创建 VPN 隧道实现设备自调试，需配合开发者镜像使用。主要应用于 iOS 性能优化、模拟器开发及逆向工程，为开发者提供绕过系统限制的灵活调试方案。
repos.summary_en: Jitterbug is an innovative debugging tool that enables JIT compilation on non-jailbroken iOS devices by leveraging WiFi pairing between two iOS devices through libimobiledevice. It facilitates tethered app launches with debugger attachment and creates VPN tunnels for self-debugging scenarios. The solution requires Developer Disk Images and supports installation via AltStore or sideloading. Primary use cases include iOS performance optimization, simulator development, and security research, offering developers a flexible approach to bypass Apple's JIT restrictions while maintaining device security integrity.

repos.summary_zh: AppStore++ 是一款基于 TrollStore 的 iOS 越狱插件，允许用户直接降级已安装的 App 至任意历史版本。它集成 AppStore 搜索、版本兼容性检测、IPA 库管理及应用数据备份，支持 iPad 分屏界面，为越狱用户提供便捷的应用版本管理方案。
repos.summary_en: AppStore++ is a TrollStore-based iOS jailbreak tweak that lets users downgrade installed apps to any historical version. It integrates App Store search, version compatibility detection, IPA library management, and app-data backups, with iPad split-view support, offering a convenient app version management solution for jailbroken devices.

repos.description: How top iOS apps say hello | 10 animated welcome screens inspired by top-earning apps. Rebuilt in React Native + Expo.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 React Native Expo 项目，收录 10 个受 Duolingo、Strava 等热门 iOS 应用启发的动画欢迎/启动/引导屏幕。每个均为完整 TypeScript 组件，基于 Reanimated 实现精准时间轴动画、响应式缩放、无障碍与减动画支持。开发者可直接运行画廊、复制组件或粘贴 AI 提示词快速集成，专为学习高端移动端 onboarding 设计而打造。
repos.summary_en: Open-source React Native Expo kit with 10 animated welcome, splash and onboarding screens inspired by top iOS apps like Duolingo and Strava. Each is a full TypeScript component powered by Reanimated, featuring authored timelines, responsive scaling, reduced-motion and accessibility support. Run the gallery, copy any component or paste AI prompts to integrate polished mobile onboarding UI for study or production use.

repos.description: crate: run Linux VMs on iPhone and iPad
repos.summary_zh: crate是一款在iPhone和iPad上运行完整Linux发行版的虚拟机应用，完全在设备本地运行，无需远程连接或云端依赖。它采用Rust从零编写的arm64翻译引擎，性能远超QEMU TCG，支持Ubuntu、Debian和Arch Linux ARM，通过virglrenderer、ANGLE和MoltenVK实现GPU加速桌面，并针对触摸、键盘和折叠屏优化，让手机变成真正的Linux电脑，支持Claude Code等开发工具。
repos.summary_en: crate is a virtual machine app that runs full Linux distributions on iPhone and iPad, entirely on-device with no remote connection or cloud dependency. Powered by a Rust-based arm64 translation engine that outperforms QEMU TCG, it supports Ubuntu, Debian, and Arch Linux ARM with GPU-accelerated desktops via virglrenderer, ANGLE, and MoltenVK, and is optimized for touch, keyboard, and foldable screens, turning your phone into a real Linux computer that can run developer tools like Claude Code.

repos.description: A playground for live Metal shaders on iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro and Apple Watch. Save any shader as a wallpaper.
